publishedMetadata.title: Async submissions
publishedMetadata.description: Prevent duplicate side effects and reuse one idempotency key for retries of the same logical request. This guided lab analyzes and repairs a real React Hook Form state or submission failure.
objectives: Prevent duplicate side effects and reuse one idempotency key for retries of the same logical request.
Simulate an accepted 201 with a lost response. Retry must preserve both body and key. Double-click while pending and verify no second fetch starts.
An in-memory idempotency key protects only one process lifetime. Real billing/financial mutations require durable server-side deduplication.
rubric: Prevent duplicate side effects and reuse one idempotency key for retries of the same logical request.
